_about: On-call rota for operator pages (SAFETY SEMANTICS 63; wgresponse.paging). The watcher reads oncall/rota.json in its private S3 state prefix (or watch --rota PATH) every minute. Copy this template there and fill it in. NEVER commit real names or contact details to the repo. people: id -> name + contact details (read only by a real channel; the channel is dry until the SMS provider, OPEN_QUESTIONS O-1, is chosen). shifts: UTC start/end with a primary and a secondary; the covering shift that started last is on call. season: fire-season date ranges; [] = all year (24/7, the safe default until the season dates are set).
